companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Assystem is now one of the world's three leading independent nuclear engineering companies. With more than 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial players in the implementation of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and is involved in the entire project life cycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
**Job Responsibilities**

For an upcoming major infrastructure project, we are scouting for the following talent to fill critical leadership positions:

**Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure (15+ years exp)**

  • Oversee end-to-end project delivery for infrastructure components, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, budgets, and resource plans
  • Lead cross-functional teams and coordinate with external stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution
  • Monitor project performance against KPIs and implement corrective actions as needed
  • Manage project risks, issues, and changes through established governance frameworks

**Senior Project Manager - Building (15+ years exp)**

  • Direct all aspects of building construction and development, from planning through completion
  • Ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, and contractors to maintain project specifications
  • Track construction progress and manage budget expenditures
  • Facilitate communication between project teams and stakeholders

**Senior Project Manager - Utilities (15+ years exp)**

  • Manage utility infrastructure projects including water, power, and telecommunications systems
  • Coordinate with utility providers and regulatory agencies to ensure project compliance
  • Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of utility systems
  • Maintain detailed documentation and reporting on utility project milestones
  • Address technical challenges and implement solutions to maintain project momentum

**HSE Manager (15+ years exp)**

  • Develop and implement comprehensive health, safety, and environmental policies and procedures
  • Conduct regular safety audits and inspections across all project sites
  • Investigate incidents and implement preventive measures to minimize workplace hazards
  • Provide safety training and awareness programs for all project personnel
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations and industry best practices

**Contract and Procurement Manager (15+ years exp)**

  • Develop procurement strategies and manage vendor selection processes
  • Negotiate contracts and agreements with suppliers and service providers
  • Monitor contract performance and ensure adherence to terms and conditions
  • Manage procurement budgets and track expenditures
  • Maintain vendor relationships and resolve procurement-related disputes

**Risk Manager (18+ years exp)**

  • Identify, assess, and quantify project risks across all disciplines
  • Develop risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans
  • Monitor risk indicators and provide regular risk reporting to senior leadership
  • Facilitate risk workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions
  • Implement risk management tools and processes throughout the project lifecycle

**Stakeholder Manager (15+ years exp)**

  • Develop and execute stakeholder engagement strategies and communication plans
  • Maintain relationships with government agencies, community groups, and other key stakeholders
  • Organize and facilitate stakeholder meetings and public consultations
  • Address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations throughout project delivery
  • Prepare stakeholder reports and manage project communications

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
**Required Qualifications:**

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, project management, construction management, or relevant technical discipline
  • Minimum 15+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, construction, or related project management (18+ years for Risk Manager role)
  • Professional Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated expertise in managing large-scale infrastructure projects with budgets exceeding $50 million
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices
  • Proficiency in project management software and tools (MS Project, Primavera, or similar)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  • Advanced degree (Master's) in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
  • Additional certifications relevant to specific role (e.g., NEBOSH for HSE, CIPS for Procurement, or Risk Management certifications)
  • Experience with public-private partnerships (PPP) or government-funded infrastructure projects
  • Track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget
  • Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams across diverse stakeholder groups
  • Knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for infrastructure projects
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentoring capabilities for senior-level positions

• Financial Record Keeping: Maintain and update the general ledger, ensuring all financial transactions (journal entries, receipts, and disbursements) are accurately coded and recorded.

  • Accounts Receivable & Payable: Manage vendor invoicing, verify payment approvals, process accounts payable, and track aging accounts receivable to ensure timely collections.

  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly bank reconciliations, intercompany balance reconciliations, and subsidiary ledger reviews to resolve any discrepancies.

  • Compliance & Taxation: Assist in the preparation and filing of quarterly/monthly VAT returns in strict compliance with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) regulations. Ensure all e-invoicing standards are met.

  • Reporting: Prepare preliminary balance sheets, profit & loss statements, and cash flow reports for management review.

  • Audit Support: Provide necessary documentation, schedules, and analytical support to external and internal auditors during annual financial audits.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

  • Lead and manage commercial, contracts, and project controls functions across major capital projects and programs.
  • Develop and implement project controls frameworks, procedures, governance systems, and reporting structures.
  • Oversee cost control, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and earned value analysis.
  • Lead planning and scheduling activities including integrated master schedules, progress monitoring, and recovery plans.
  • Manage contract administration activities including claims, variation orders, disputes, and contractual correspondence.
  • Provide strategic commercial guidance to executive leadership and project delivery teams.
  • Review and negotiate EPC, EPCM, PMC, consultancy, and subcontract agreements.
  • Ensure compliance with company standards, client requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Lead project risk management activities including identification, mitigation, and reporting.
  • Oversee preparation of executive dashboards, KPIs, cost reports, schedule reports, and portfolio performance reports.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and operations teams to ensure project alignment.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams including planners, cost engineers, contracts engineers, and project controls specialists.
  • Support project delivery through performance monitoring, critical path analysis, and schedule recovery initiatives.
  • Participate in executive meetings, steering committees, and stakeholder management activities.
  • Ensure proper implementation of change management and document control procedures.
  • Support claims management and dispute resolution through detailed commercial and schedule analysis.
  • Develop and track key project KPIs

  • Successful delivery of projects within approved budget and schedule.
  • Effective implementation of project controls governance and reporting systems.
  • Improved cost visibility, forecasting accuracy, and commercial performance.
  • Timely identification and mitigation of project risks and delays.
  • Effective administration of contracts, claims, and variation orders.
  • Achievement of project KPIs and client satisfaction targets.
  • Accurate and timely executive reporting and dashboard management.
  • Improved stakeholder coordination and communication.
  • Efficient management of multidisciplinary project controls teams.
  • Compliance with contractual, financial, and organizational requirements.
  • Continuous improvement of commercial and project controls processes.

Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia & Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low-carbon energy.

We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.

Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.

To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our team on a remote basis, supporting a major project in Riyadh. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in data analysis, business intelligence, and transforming data into actionable insights to support decision-making and operational performance.
 

  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights
  • Develop dashboards and reports using BI tools (e.g., Power BI)
  • Perform data cleaning, validation, and data quality checks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements
  • Support data-driven decision-making through clear reporting and visualization

Automate reporting processes where applicable

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in data analysis or similar role
  • Proficiency in Power BI, SQL, and Excel
  • Knowledge of Python or other data tools is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to interpret data and present clear insights
  • Good communication skills in English (Arabic is a plus)

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Finding solutions to climate change is the priority of the 21st century, and means switching to low-carbon energy. At Assystem, our mission is to accelerate the energy transition worldwide. To achieve this, our 7,500 Switchers combine their historical engineering expertise and project management with digital technologies.

In our 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Asia) of operation, we are working on the production and distribution of low-carbon electricity, through the development of nuclear and renewable energies. We are also supporting the modernisation and development of energy grids, managing the setup and siting for new transmission and distribution networks, and using hydrogen to decarbonise the transport and industry sectors.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Business Development OR Proposal Specialist will support and execute business development activities for the Siting & Environmental Services portfolio, with a primary focus on Saudi Arabia. The role involves identifying opportunities, supporting bids, managing client relationships, and contributing to growth initiatives aligned with Assystem’s strategic objectives.

    Job-Specific & Generic Skills

    • Solid understanding of engineering consultancy and environmental services
    • Good knowledge of Saudi Arabian markets
    • Experience in bid preparation, tender submissions, and client presentations
    • Strong relationship management and communication skills
    • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and project teams
    • Commercial awareness with the ability to identify and support growth opportunities
    • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously

    Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

    Business Development & Opportunity Support

    • Support the development and execution of business development plans for the Siting & Environmental Services portfolio
    • Identify, track, and qualify new business opportunities with clients, authorities, and developers
    • Assist in managing the full bid lifecycle, including expressions of interest, proposals, and negotiations
    • Coordinate with technical teams to ensure client requirements are well understood and addressed

    Client & Stakeholder Engagement

    • Support the BU Director in building and maintaining client relationships
    • Act as a point of contact for assigned clients and opportunities
    • Participate in client meetings, presentations, and workshops
    • Represent Assystem professionally at industry events and networking forums

    Market Intelligence & Strategy Support

    • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and regulatory developments
    • Provide inputs to support market positioning and service development
    • Maintain an updated opportunity pipeline and market intelligence database

    Collaboration & Internal Coordination

    • Work closely with engineering, environmental, and project teams to support proposals and client engagements
    • Contribute to the preparation of high-quality bids and presentations
    • Support knowledge sharing and best practices across the business unit

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Minimum Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geosciences, Environmental Engineering, or a related field
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or Engineering is an advantage

Experience

  • 8–12 years of experience in business development, commercial, Tendering or Proposals within engineering, environmental, or consultancy sectors
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or leading bids, proposals, and client engagements in the KSA market
  • Exposure to Saudi Vision 2030 projects is a strong advantage
